description: Executable Candidate adaptation of MiaAI-Lab's two-DGX-Spark Inkling Small NVFP4 profile: SGLang TP2 over RoCE with RadixArk's DSpark Preview draft (block size 7), the fp4_mx_block16 KV cache and a 1M-token context, on drowzeys' prebuilt KV-quant GB10 SGLang image pinned by digest. Launch flags are upstream's text-only set (no --enable-multimodal); throughput figures in upstream's README are its own claims.
title: Inkling Small NVFP4 SGLang DSpark two Sparks (Mia)
